# Finality Post

> Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum and beyond: market moves, protocol upgrades, exchange and DeFi developments, regulation, security incidents and funding.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://ethereumnews.github.io/): latest reporting and analysis.
- [About](https://ethereumnews.github.io/about/): editorial scope, independence, sourcing and corrections.
- [Archive](https://ethereumnews.github.io/archive/): everything published.
